title: SPF decoded
caption: SPF numbers measure how long a sunscreen extends your skin's resistance to UVB rays — not how much UV it blocks. In Dubai, that calculation shifts fast: heat, sweat, and constant AC transitions break down most formulas within 90 minutes of real wear. A factor-50 sunscreen applied once at 8am isn't protecting you at noon. Reapplication is the mechanic that actually does the work. Knowing that turns SPF from a morning habit into a daytime strategy. Not medical advice, just the honest basics. Learn more at cliniclick.ae
